description.value: The CF-101 Voodoo (tail number 101035) is a Cold War-era RCAF fighter-interceptor that stands on a pedestal at the entrance to the Abbotsford International Airport. The aircraft served in the RCAF from 1961 to 1987 and was transferred to the Abbotsford International Airshow Society in 1992 following its retirement. It is a visible roadside landmark for anyone cycling past or to the airport in the Fraser Valley.
